post.description:
Allows uploading and saving document types: INVOICE, RETURNSLIP, PICKINGSLIP, OTHER (codes: RE, EXRE, LS and OT, respectively).
Expected file types: PDF, image (JPEG, PNG, SVG).
Returns the saved file's details.

requestBody.description:
Request for uploading a file for order.
At least one order ID is required (ordernr, extordernr or orderuuid).
Non-empty order IDs are processed in order and multiple order IDs must match (reference the same order).
Allowed document types: INVOICE, RETURNSLIP, PICKINGSLIP, OTHER (codes: RE, EXRE, LS and OT, respectively).

orderQuantities.description:
Position defined by positionuuid gets split based on order quantities.
Delivery quantity of the existing position has to be lower or equal to the FIRST entry in the orderquantity list,
because delivery quantity cannot be split.
example: existing position.orderquantity = 15, request: orderQuantities = [5,3,7] --> three positions get created (position.orderquantity = 5, position.orderquantity = 3, position.orderquantity = 7)
result: existing position's order quantity gets updated to 5 and two new positions with order quantity 3, respectively 7 gets created.

UploadDocumentRequest.description:
Request for uploading a file for order.
At least one order ID is required (ordernr, extordernr or orderuuid).
Non-empty order IDs are processed in order and multiple order IDs must match (reference the same order).
Allowed document types: INVOICE, RETURNSLIP, PICKINGSLIP, OTHER (codes: RE, EXRE, LS and OT, respectively).
